notes.title: Degauss launch sale ending soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30973808/90a51882013636f6028ded833adf1f5b6c086f27.gif[/img]

It's hard to believe, but Degauss has been out for almost a week now! To celebrate the launch with everyone, we launched with a sale to share our excitement with you. But that sale is ending soon, so if you haven't picked it up yet, now is your chance!
